name: black-heart-v1
prompt: Draw one production sprite sheet of 16 genuinely hand-drawn animation frames (4 columns by 4 rows) for Bullets of Fury, HD Neo-Geo arcade pixel art. Use the reference ONLY for the black biomechanical tendrils, glistening near-black material, thin red cracks and violet light vocabulary. The subject is ONE sinister beating BLACK SYMBIOTE HEART, with a small fixed deep-red central pupil, NOT a portal, ring or full creature. Black organic fragments gather into an anatomical alien heart: frames 1-4 separated black droplets rising toward center, 5-8 join veins/lobes, 9-12 the completed heart pulses once with folding veins, 13-16 second pulse relaxing. The completed object has a solid black core and thin crimson and violet vein highlights, tiny silver/gray rim edges for readability. Keep the heart's physical center exactly fixed in every equal cell and use the same scale; only lobes/veins contract and fragments approach. All sprites contained within middle 65% of each cell, huge transparent gutters and perimeter safety margin, no crossing cells, no clipped tendrils. Crisp authored pixels, no blur, no smears, no written numbers or labels. Transparent background, square whole sheet.

name: furnace-wave-v1-rejected
prompt: Draw ONE game-ready animation spritesheet of exactly 16 frames, 4 equal columns x 4 equal rows. HD Neo-Geo premium pixel art, sharp white-yellow fire core, orange-red flames, black outline in the embers. A wide bowed FIRE WAVE projectile flying straight downward at the viewer: the shape is like a flaming shallow crescent or bow front, its two wings curve back upward. This is a FREE FLYING transverse fire wave, not a beam, not a vertical geyser, not a ring. Each frame the same centered 150px wide by 80px high wave body, a fixed central hot spot exactly at cell center, animate churning flames and curling tips with 16 real unique drawn frames that loop cleanly. Consistent center, dimensions and direction; do not translate/rotate/resize the whole projectile. Complete visible flame tips within middle 65% of every equal cell, transparent gutters 20% between sprites, transparent background, no frames cross cells, no labels or borders or text. Maintain a solid readable front. Square whole sheet.

name: furnace-wave-v2
prompt: Repair the layout of THIS EXACT 16-frame fire-wave animation sheet. Retain the sixteen beautiful orange crescent projectile designs and frame order. They currently touch and clip at the cell sides: that is unacceptable. Redraw/re-layout them at ONLY 55 PERCENT of each cell width. Each flame wave must have at least 22 percent cell-width of EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE TO ITS LEFT and RIGHT, and 25 percent empty transparent space ABOVE and BELOW. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen equal square cells, perfectly aligned central hot spot, constant scale for all frames. Every flame tip must be wholly visible. No cells may touch, no partial cut-off flames at the outside canvas edge. A square sheet with huge transparent gutters. Keep the same crisp detailed HD Neo-Geo fire palette, same down-facing flying crescent, no letters or numbers.
